observation.visible_scene: A black bowl filled with a reddish-brown liquid sits against a black background. In the center of the bowl is a fluffy, coral-like mass featuring distinct patches of orange, blue, green, yellow, and pale pink/white.
visible_changes: The multi-colored fluffy mass slowly expands and grows in size throughout the clip.
The structure becomes slightly more diffuse and voluminous, with the colored sections spreading outward and downward into the liquid.
The overall shape of the mass changes from a more compact cluster to a larger, sprawling formation.
outside_clip_unknowns: The specific chemical reaction or material causing the growth.
The start and end of the entire growth process.
The composition of the liquid and the solid mass.
uncertain_details: Whether the liquid level is changing or if the mass is simply growing over it.
If there is any subtle camera movement versus purely object growth.
